- [Projects](https://austinrobichaux.com/projects): case studies of work and side projects

## Investment Calculator

https://austinrobichaux.com/other-modules/investment-calculator

Projects investment growth (starting amount + regular contributions, compounded), shows the result in today's dollars, and estimates a yearly retirement withdrawal. A household-budget widget estimates take-home pay and leftover money to invest.

### Building a scenario link

Every input can be set with a query parameter, so you can build a link that opens the calculator with a specific scenario. Only the parameters you include change; everything else uses its default. The page's "Copy Share Link" button produces the same format, and "Copy Summary for AI" copies the inputs and results as JSON.

Example: https://austinrobichaux.com/other-modules/investment-calculator?startingAmount=25000&contribution=1500&interestRate=8&currentAge=35&goalAmount=2000000

Numbers are plain (no $ or %; commas are fine). Percentages are whole numbers (8 = 8%).

- startingAmount: starting balance in dollars
- contribution: contribution amount in dollars, per contributionFrequency; negative withdraws that much each period (balance stops at $0)
- contributionFrequency: monthly | annually
- contributionTiming: end | beginning
- interestRate: annual return, percent
- compounding: annually | semiannually | quarterly | monthly | daily | continuously
- inflationRate: annual inflation, percent (for today's-dollars figures)
- withdrawalRate: yearly withdrawal rate in retirement, percent of balance
- currentAge: current age in years (empty clears it)
- incomes: comma-separated; each is yearly:<amount>, monthly:<amount>, or hourly:<rate>:<hoursPerWeek>:<weeksPerYear> (a bare number is yearly)
- state: two-letter U.S. state code; fills that state's tax rate and average cost of living
- stateTaxRate: state income tax rate, percent
- withholdings: paycheck withholdings (401k, insurance, etc.) per withholdingsFrequency
- withholdingsFrequency: weekly | biweekly | semimonthly | monthly | annually
- costOfLiving: monthly cost of living in dollars
- checking: current checking balance (toward a 3-month buffer)
- savings: current HYSA/savings balance (toward a 6-month buffer)
- ignoreSaved: 1 to skip the checking/HYSA buffers
- boosts: future contribution increases, |-separated; each is age:<age>:<extraMonthly>:<label> or year:<yearsFromNow>:<extraMonthly>:<label>; add -<end> to stop it at that age/year; suffix the amount with y for yearly, e.g. age:50-60:6000y:Side job
- years, months: time horizon (max 200 years; months 0-11)
- todaysDollars: 1 to treat goalAmount/goalWithdrawal as today's (inflation-adjusted) dollars
- retirementAge: target retirement age; holds it fixed and derives the horizon (needs currentAge)
- goalAmount: target balance in dollars; holds it fixed and solves for the horizon
- goalWithdrawal: target yearly withdrawal in dollars (excludes Social Security); holds it fixed and solves for the horizon
- hold: horizon | age | amount | withdrawal — which linked field stays fixed when other inputs change

### In-browser agents (WebMCP)

In browsers that support WebMCP (navigator.modelContext), the calculator page registers these tools:

- get_investment_scenario: current inputs, headline results, and a share link
- set_investment_inputs: change any of the parameters above (same names and formats); returns the updated results
- reset_investment_calculator: reset all inputs to defaults
